decisions.reason: Despite its absence from the website after 2019, the desk system is tightly aligned with the firm's office and conference capabilities and may have been folded into the broader portfolio, so the option is still worth keeping open.
A chair family sits very close to the core offer and can usually be maintained with limited incremental cost, so even with weak later visibility it remains a sensible adjacent product to retain.
The floor cushions are peripheral to the main furniture business and, after several years without observable market presence, the remaining upside no longer justifies keeping this option alive.
This sofa already showed the weakest early signal and its continued non-observation strongly indicates that its value has been revealed as too low relative to other uses of resources.
The high standing table fits the firm's direction toward flexible contemporary workplaces and is a relatively low-risk adjacent offer, so it is still reasonable to keep it available.

Although strategically important as a flagship move into holistic interiors, the rug collection is more distant from the core business and prolonged lack of visible traction suggests the experiment should now be ended.
